name: Welding cell 3D view
summary: The car factory welding cell live in 3D while a run goes on: rail and sled, the car body frame, four KUKA robots with swan-neck torches and laser seam cameras, sparks, seams turning to welds, and the
help: Live while the Welding cell block runs (EsaSim's 3D view shows the recorded cars when the block has finished). Wire the Welding cell block's telemetry (through a Telemetry block, channels cell, event, sensor, line, train) to Live, and a dataset with kr210_weld.glb and the car frame (.glb) to Models; without models, simple stand-ins are drawn. Buttons: Cell, Top, Along the rail, the robots, and Follow torch 1 / 3 (the camera rides with the torch). The bottom row shows each robot's last laser profile: red dots the profile, the green ring where the network says the joint is, the white cross where it really is (mm across / in depth).
